in_sanskrit.name: Ziya
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Life, Radiant
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ziya एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ziya is derived from the Marathi word 'zya' which means 'life'. It is also associated with the Sanskrit word 'jivan', meaning 'radiant'. In Hindu mythology, Ziya is considered to be a name of Goddess Durga, the divine mother who bestows life and protects her children.
